The '''Iritsa Civil Guard''' was the local law enforcement agency on [[Iritsa]]. They wore green uniforms and carried [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistols. They usually patrolled by [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] or [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], but rarely on foot.
